{{Top|leg}}
'''The Block''' was an area of the shopping district of [[Byrne City]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Demophon]]. It was where those with the [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] could purchase [[Sla Kar]]s who were considered too old or weak to work in the [[Mining/Legends|mines]] to use them as servants.
